no_adcom_quote.quote: regadenoson was not discussed at an advisory committee due to the development program's demonstration of persuasive evidence that it is very similar to Adenoscan, a marketed drug.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Lexiscan (regadenoson, NDA022161). The Summary Review states regadenoson was not discussed at an advisory committee because the development program showed persuasive evidence it is very similar to the marketed drug Adenoscan, and the Medical Review likewise records that a meeting was not needed. With no AdComm held, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
